name: qkd_kv_landing_cal
purpose: Q-VMWB 2026-10-16: landing-side KV calendar leaf (KV die MISSING_PRODUCER, Q-KVSYS-DIE request): one master, 32 per die beside each static landing group; drives the group's arm/epoch/layer/expected_put/sector and its 4 return slots' expected_* from compiled kgo/vgo, T and boot cfg. Static: no data/ready/credit input. PH0 = die beat-aligned reset phase (0).
